# Skilleaze

> Skilleaze (Skilleaze Global LLP, Puttur, Karnataka, India) is a career services company. Tagline: Career Simplified. Experts write ATS-friendly CVs, Europass CVs, cover letters, LinkedIn and job portal profiles, build personal portfolio websites and run 1-to-1 interview preparation for job seekers in India, the UAE, the GCC and worldwide. Skilleaze never fabricates experience and does not guarantee jobs, interviews or ATS results.

Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+971 56 705 3289) or by email (hello@skilleaze.com). Scope, timeline and price are confirmed before payment. Payments are non-refundable once work has started. Current prices include a 50% launch offer.

## Services

- [ATS-Optimized CV](https://www.skilleaze.com/ats-cv/): INR 490 / AED 20 / USD 6. Clean, role-aligned CV that applicant tracking systems can parse.
- [Europass CV](https://www.skilleaze.com/europass-cv/): INR 590 / AED 25 / USD 9. Standard European CV format with CEFR language levels.
- [Cover Letter](https://www.skilleaze.com/cover-letter/): INR 100 / AED 5 / USD 2. Tailored one-page letter for a specific role.
- [LinkedIn Profile Optimization](https://www.skilleaze.com/linkedin/): INR 690 / AED 30 / USD 10. Headline, About, experience and keywords.
- [Job Portal Optimization](https://www.skilleaze.com/job-portals/): INR 690 / AED 30 / USD 10 per portal. Naukri, Naukrigulf, Bayt, GulfTalent, Indeed, Foundit and Shine.
- [Personal Portfolio Website](https://www.skilleaze.com/portfolio-website/): INR 990 / AED 39 / USD 15. Mobile-friendly site for projects and experience.
- [1-to-1 Interview Preparation](https://www.skilleaze.com/interview-prep/): INR 2,000 / AED 79 / USD 25 per one-hour session with an industry leader.
